name: Customize Add to Cart Button Text
author: Abdur Rahman

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to change/customize the “Add to cart” Button text, Used to buy a product in WooCommerce. You will be able to use different custom texts for:

Single product page:

  • Simple product (default: Add to cart)
  • External/Affiliate product (default: Buy product)
  • Grouped product (default: Select Options)
  • Variable product (default: Select Options)

Archive pages (shop, category, tags…):

  • Simple product (default: Add to cart)
  • External/Affiliate product (default: Buy product)
  • Grouped product (default: Select Options)
  • Variable product (default: Select Options)

Just activate it and go to “Add to Cart Button Text” from Admin menu on WordPress dasboard and after that you will be able to see input fields to add your desired text to replace “Add to cart” Button text.

Plugin Documentation: https://wordpress.org/plugins/customize-add-to-cart-button-text/

You can make my day by submitting a positive review on WordPress.org!
sections.faq:
Is Customize Add to Cart Button Text free plugin?

Yes, Its free WordPress Plugin.

Can I use HTML tags in the button text?

No, that isn’t supported.
